title: ALINA accessibility & performance acceptance
goal: Prove the combined ALINA v1 product across scenarios, performance tiers, responsive modes and accessibility fallbacks before release hardening.
why: Subsystem tests are green, but release confidence requires a product-level acceptance matrix and explicit known limitations.
constraints: richer tiers cannot be the only path to task completion
unknown runtime measurements must be reported, not silently passed
all five product scenarios must be covered
keyboard and reduced-motion paths are mandatory
acceptanceCriteria: keyboard focus and reduced motion pass
